HRA Analysis: BLING YOUR A GAME (4) ran a good second last time out behind Uncle Nolan last time out when sitting without cover. He is likely to have derived good benefit from the outing and looks to find a suitable race. RESERVED FOR ME (3) was badly checked last time out and lost plenty of ground at a crucial stage before finishing fourth behind Uncle Nolan. She should get a good run close to the speed and can be looking to run second. CHILL ILL BELL YOU (5) made a break last time out taking no part in the race there. He doesn’t quite capable of challenging the top two in this race but can be running into the placings late. HEY CHARGER (2) was well beaten in a recent trial behind Magic Jujon. She is likely to have derived benefit from the outing and can run well on debut. SELECTIONS: BLING YOUR A GAME (4), RESERVED FOR ME (3), CHILL ILL BELL YOU (5), HEY CHARGER (2) SUGGESTED BET: BLING YOUR A GAME (4) to win.

MACKEL SONNY (3) has been racing well recently despite doing a few things wrong in races. He drew poorly last time out getting a long way back and running on late. If he can bring his best manners he can run well again. SECOND TO NUN (5) got back last time out and was running on late behind Calders Revenge. With a safe beginning she should settle close enough in the run and can be running on late. BUSTER DAN (7) has a big handicap to overcome in this race but has been in excellent form. He secured a good run behind the leader two starts ago and was able to sprint best to score. THE RED MENACE (1) has a big handicap advantage in this race after battling on fairly at Marburg recently. He is likely to have derived benefit from the first up outing and should run well. SELECTIONS: MACKEL SONNY (3), SECOND TO NUN (5), BUSTER DAN (7), THE RED MENACE (1) SUGGESTED BET: MACKEL SONNY (3) to win.

MAJESTIC LAVROS (5) has excellent gate speed and may be able to zip across and lead this race. He was shuffled back in a stronger race last time out which was taken out by Keayang Stuka. LEAF STRIDE (7) was a good winner last time out when running over the top and holding off the late challenge of SHEEETWEB WEAVER (4). He draws poorly in this race outside the front row and may need to do some work or could be shuffled a long way back. SHEETWEB WEAVER (4) ran well last start when just coming up a touch short behind LEAF STRIDE (7). He has early speed and should settle close from a prominent draw. WHIRLWIND WILBUR (3) got back last time out and wasn’t able to get into the race there. He could settle a touch closer this time and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: MAJESTIC LAVROS (5), LEAF STRIDE (7), SHEETWEB WEAVER (4), WHIRLWIND WILBUR (3) SUGGESTED BET:

VODKA EN ICE (4) has good gate speed and has always been a horse which loves to lead which he may be able to do in this race. He was forced to race without cover and battled on well there for a very close up sixth. POCKET BOOK (11) was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on well there for second behind Party Changer. She is likely to get back in this race and if the race is run to suit he should be running on strongly. MAYWYNS KAREN (12) secured a good run close to the speed last time out and ran well for second. She draws outside the back row in this race and will need a few things to go her way to get into the race. ALSROKSTAR (1) has good gate speed and should be able to lead before having options from there. He trialled up reasonably at this track and can run well on return with a soft run behind the speed. SELECTIONS: VODKA EN ICE (4), POCKET BOOK (11), MAYWYNS KAREN (12), ALSROKSTAR (1) SUGGESTED BET: VODKA EN ICE (4) to win.

MAGIC MIKI (3) has the draw advantage over a number of his key rivals in this race and may be able to press forward and find the lead in this race. He was forced to race without cover on return from a spell and battled away well for third behind Race For Riches. SHANKYS SHOT (6) draws poorly on return in this race. Was very good in his latest race starts when running on strongly late into second behind Luvtobeuptome in the Consolation of the QLD Derby. SURREAL MORAN (1) has good gate speed and should be able to lead before having options front here. He trialled up well recently running second to Move It Lou ahead of his return in this race. MY ULTIMATE ZANDER (5) secured a good run behind the speed last time out and battled away fairly there for fifth behind stablemate Fire And Passion. He draws quite awkwardly in this race and may need a few things to go his way. SELECTIONS: MAGIC MIKI (3), SHANKYS SHOT (6), SURREAL MORAN (1), MY ULTIMATE ZANDER (5) SUGGESTED BET: MAGIC MIKI (3) to win.

PINKCHAMPAGNE (1) went very close to crossing last time out and just couldn’t quite get there before being left without cover and was able to battle away well there. She should be able to lead this time and should be very hard to run down. TIGER TOMMY (3) got back in the run last time out and was running on best late to score there. She should get a good run again close to the speed and can be running on late. WARRAWEE FLYER (7) draws poorly outside the front row in this race. She drew poorly last time out and was running on nicely late into fifth behind Powermove. GOING FOR GOLD (8) was beaten a long way last time out at this track over the 2138. He may be better suited in this race getting a soft run behind the speed and can look to bounce back. SELECTIONS: PINKCHAMPAGNE (1), TIGER TOMMY (3), WARRAWEE FLYER (7), GOING FOR GOLD (8) SUGGESTED BET: PINKCHAMPAGNE (1) to win.

ROCKY WINE (7) has been racing in very good form and appears to be closing in on another win. She got back in the run last time out and was running on strongly behind Fit And Ready. She may find this a touch easier and can run well again. MY ULTIMATE MARIO (2) sat without cover last time out and battled on nicely there for second at this track and trip. He may be able to work to the lead this time and if he can he should take plenty of running down. GOODOLDBOYSANDBEER (10) draws poorly on the back row in this race and will likely need a few things to go his way in the run. He got back in the run last time out and was making up some ground behind Sweet Lad Jujon. POWERMOVE (1) was able to work to the lead before taking a sit and ran down the leader there Longshot late. She should secure a similar trip behind the speed in this race and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: ROCKY WINE (7), MY ULTIMATE MARIO (2), GOODOLDBOYSANDBEER (10), POWERMOVE (1) SUGGESTED BET: ROCKY WINE (7) to win. OVERVIEW:DISTANT SUN (1) has been racing super without winning recently. She has been flashing home well late and gets a change of luck here with the better barrier. PARIS KAY (7) got it wrong with her manners last start, so we can forget that run. Her start prior was a second in the Swan Hill Trotters Cup, where she ran well chasing down the getaway winner. She is one of the classier horses in this race, but the barrier is tricky. LITTLE MISS MORGAN (9) is a smart mare who won well last start at Maryborough, flashing home from last. She beat DISTANT SUN (1) on that occasion, however, the barrier suits DISTANT SUN (1) here. ZARSKI (4) has a massive motor and a lot of ability, but his quirks bring risk. He galloped last start and can do things wrong. If he’s on his best behaviour, he’s one of, if not the most talented horses in this field. Also respecting WALLIS (2), who let down nicely for third last start. With some luck, he can be prominent here. BACK: DISTANT SUN (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: DISTANT SUN (1), PARIS KAY (7), LITTLE MISS MORGAN (9), ZARSKI (4)

OVERVIEW:ICANMOTOR (9) is a 20-time winner and finds a suitable race here, particularly with a maiden also in the field. He’s been out of the winner’s circle since finding a purple patch of form late last year. He sustained a three-wide run last start and still battled on well for fifth. He’s racing okay and barrier nine suits. FAKE CULLECTION (10) needs to overcome a wide back-row barrier, but she is racing okay. She was narrowly beaten at Kilmore last start after flashing home brilliantly. IMAGUNNARESTNGO (7) was in a race restricted to NR up to 45 last start and drops back to NR up to 38 here. It was an interesting run, as he seemed to be struggling to keep up with the horses in front of him at the bell, but then picked up the bit again late and let down okay. He’s not the fastest beginner, so he will likely drift back to the rear of the field and need some luck, but it’s a suitable race. OKTOLOVE (6) is one for the exotics if he gets some luck. If JOEYS HANGOVER (10), the emergency, gains a start, he’s a winning chance and would have likely been my top selection. SELECTIONS: ICANMOTOR (9), FAKE CULLECTION (10), IMAGUNNARESTNGO (7), OKTOLOVE (6)

OVERVIEW:TED BEAR (9) won impressively two starts ago at Melton, flashing around the field to win. Last start, he tired after leading. If he’s saved for one run here, he will be flashing home late. LORIMERMAJOR (2) was second behind the smart mare Harley Lane recently at Kilmore. He had barrier two on that occasion, settled midfield and flashed home impressively once he found clear running. He’s an experienced horse who can run well here with some luck. ANIMADO (1) was third last start after leading and tiring in the late stages. He can place again here from the barrier. CATIES SON (3) is third-up here and should be back to near peak fitness. Forget last start, when he hit the barrier arm and galloped, but still let down well late after catching the field. He is a smart horse at his best. BACK: TED BEAR (9) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: TED BEAR (9), LORIMERMAJOR (2), ANIMADO (1), CATIES SON (3)

OVERVIEW: This is an interesting race with many first starters. CATCH A BUTTERFLY (9) has all the ticks on paper to make her a nice filly. She is a full sister to Catch A Wave and a half-sister to Yambukian. She is trained by Emma Stewart and her trial form has been good, albeit in slow time. Looking forward to following this filly. ALWAYS BE VICKI (6) is a New Zealand-bred filly for Craig Demmler having her first career start. She has looked really good, winning her two Melton trials. In both trials, she was strong to the line but also under a grip, looking like she has a lot to offer. LIL SPARROW (3) is having her first career start for Kristy Butler. She won her recent trial at Shepparton and we will learn more about her here. FLYING JACKIE (2) has one career start. She got shuffled back at Shepparton and hit the line well for second. If she had been on the fence, her final quarter would have been 27.8. If she finds a good race map here, she could be flashing home again. Also respecting ASHANTE MAJOR (8), who is out of superstar broodmare For Dear Life, making him a half-brother to Pelosi. He’s bred to be a nice horse. SELECTIONS: CATCH A BUTTERFLY (9), ALWAYS BE VICKI (6), LIL SPARROW (3), FLYING JACKIE (2)

OVERVIEW:BUSLIN BRODY (9) has had some mixed form recently when it comes to his manners. He has been getting it wrong and galloping early. However, when he has been trotting throughout, he appears to be near career-best form. Hoping he can settle here from barrier nine, do everything right and be the one crossing the line first. I CHOOSE YOU (6) flashed home well from last to finish fourth last start at Maryborough. His class was on show recently against the top level of the three-year-old trotters when he finished second behind Munny The Munster in a Vicbred Super Series heat. He can get things wrong with his manners. RASTAMON (2) has good gate speed and will likely find the fence here. He performs best when he finds the fence and is racing well. PASS THE SALT (5) is a nice horse at his best. He was shuffled back last start at Maryborough but still let down well late. BACK: BUSLIN BRODY (9)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: BUSLIN BRODY (9), I CHOOSE YOU (6), RASTAMON (2), PASS THE SALT (5)

OVERVIEW:RAPTA (4) has a lot of ability when he trots throughout. Four starts ago, he ran an eye-catching second in a Need For Speed heat against a top-quality field. Since then, he has recorded another good placing and galloped twice. If he trots, he is the one to beat here. MOONSHINE LOUIE (2) has been racing well. He hasn’t been out of the top four in eight starts. He can make his own luck and should be able to map well here from barrier two. KYVALLEY REEVA (7) can get it wrong with her manners, but when she trots, she trots impressively. She galloped last start, but her two starts prior saw her trot throughout and win very well. If she trots, she can win. ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (5) has a strong last 800 metres on the clock at her best. If she gets a good trip, she can be flashing home late. BACK: RAPTA (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: RAPTA (4), MOONSHINE LOUIE (2), KYVALLEY REEVA (7), ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (5)

OVERVIEW:KIMCHI (5) is a reliable performer who is in good form. He let down nicely from midfield to win two starts ago at Kilmore. Last start, he was three-wide with cover for the last lap and sprinted well late for second. He has another sticky barrier, but he’s versatile enough to make his own luck. OUR MYSTERY BET (1) is a consistent performer who will get a good fence trip here. TASTE IT (7) sustained a good three-wide trip to win well last start. She is racing well, but her barrier makes it tricky here. HOME AND DRY (2) was unlucky last start, held up before running home nicely once he found clear air. He has a better barrier here and gets a chance for a change of luck. BACK: KIMCHI (5)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: KIMCHI (5), OUR MYSTERY BET (1), TASTE IT (7), HOME AND DRY (2)

OVERVIEW:WHIRILY MAURZ (1) is in career-best form, winning her last two starts very well. She has the best sectional times on paper and is full of confidence. She can win again. The biggest risk to her chances is her gate speed. The horses drawn to her outside, especially HIGHVIEW HAMMER (2), have better-known gate speed than her. She is a massive chance if she can hold a forward position. HIGHVIEW HAMMER (2) does look likely to find the fence here and, from there, can take advantage of a good trip. KNOW THE SCORE (3), at his best, is a winning chance in this field. There are a few question marks around some of his recent runs, but if he can map well here, he may find a chance to get back into form. THE HEATS ON LEXY (4) could map as the horse flashing home late if she gets some luck. ABRAHAM (8) is first up in 52 days and is having his first look at the Kilmore track. SELECTIONS: WHIRILY MAURZ (1), HIGHVIEW HAMMER (2), KNOW THE SCORE (3), THE HEATS ON LEXY (4)

OVERVIEW:FROSTY DROP (1) is a smart filly with great gate speed and general high speed. If she can stay close to the front, take advantage of her fence barrier and avoid having to work too hard, she’s a big winning chance here. BLACKINDEED (3) is fourth-up here and should be close to peak race fitness. She has finished third at her last two starts and let down well last start. If she can map well, she will be in the finish. RAKAROMPA (4) is a lightly raced mare who is second-up here. She let down nicely for second last start and I am expecting an improved performance with added fitness. TRYX VIXEN (5) is a smart filly who rarely runs a bad race, but she has a sticky barrier here. SELECTIONS: FROSTY DROP (1), BLACKINDEED (3), RAKAROMPA (4), TRYX VIXEN (5) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:FLEUR BELLA (1) won twice in succession at Mildura prior to a sixth at Swan Hill, where she led out then took cover. She is a fast beginner and she boasts the terrific record of three wins from six starts on the track so she warrants respect. CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (3) began very quickly from a wide draw and ran along at a genuine tempo when he scored at Globe Derby last outing. He is drawn to obtain a prominent position again and is worth an investment. ROJENBYE (7) has the perfect trailing draw behind FLEUR BELLA (1) and is worth a ticket each way. SNEAKY PHILTRA (9) is a versatile mare and recorded a victory at Mildura against similar opposition on October 06 so she cannot be left out of calculations. SELECTIONS: FLEUR BELLA (1), CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (3), ROJENBYE (7), SNEAKY PHILTRA (9)

OVERVIEW:THE LADYBIRD (10) recorded a handy mile rate of 1.57.7 when she scored at Horsham three starts ago and appears to be well placed against this line up. She is capable of sprinting to the line quickly with the right trail forward so being drawn on the second line isn’t a big disadvantage. DAYSIE BROWN (7) will be relying on ELISSAS DELIGHT (1) holding a forward position at the start but her form last preparation would suggest she is capable of being very competitive. DIAMOND KRUSHER (8) was a winner at Mildura on September 04 after she led throughout. She has done well at Mildura this season and has claims despite being drawn on the second line. ELISSAS DELIGHT (1) is a fast beginner and finished fourth after setting the speed over the longer distance two starts ago so she is capable of filling a place. SELECTIONS: THE LADYBIRD (10), DAYSIE BROWN (7), DIAMOND KRUSHER (8), ELISSAS DELIGHT (1)

OVERVIEW: OUR MONARCH (4) is a South Australian trained pacer, which won a trial at Globe Derby then followed with a third at a Gawler trial performance in handy time. She obviously has ability and strikes a suitable assignment first up. ALWAYS BENEFITS (2) was resuming since June when he worked home well from midfield and finished fourth behind Kaidenboy at Charlton. He is better drawn for this assignment and is not without a chance. LITLMAX (6) is backing up quickly from her performance at Mildura on Friday but she was confidently driven when second at her debut performance and has the ability to feature prominently. LATHER WITH FIRE (10) is also backing up quickly from Friday afternoon’s Mildura meeting and she won a trial at Shepparton prior so she cannot be dismissed. BACK: OUR MONARCH (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: OUR MONARCH (4), ALWAYS BENEFITS (2), LITLMAX (6), LATHER WITH FIRE (10)

OVERVIEW: ACCELERE (5) is yet to miss a place in seven starts for the season and should run his usual honest race. He worked hard from a similar wide draw to find the lead and battled on nicely for second behind the smart juvenile pacer Bettorbust at Mildura last outing. HOOKLINEANDSINKER (6) suffered atrial fibrillation and was retired out of the race at Mildura last outing. He recorded handy time after working forward to find the front at Globe Derby prior so he is worth another chance. LORD MYRMECIA (1) finished off fast when an eye-catching second at Globe Derby on September 22. He is ideally drawn and looms as one of the leading chances. The South Australian trained pacers TWO WAY WONDER (3) and HARLEM TOWN (4) are both worth thought despite being unplaced at their past few attempts and CALF PEN (7) is usually competitive against this class. BACK: ACCELERE (5) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: ACCELERE (5), HOOKLINEANDSINKER (6), LORD MYRMECIA (1), TWO WAY WONDER (3)

OVERVIEW:BAZZAS LEGACY (4) is racing consistently and deserves to break through for a win. He finished third behind Tooram Danny in a stronger race at Swan Hill three starts ago, which is a strong form pointer for this event. WINSHEMAY (9) is the only horse in this race that wasn’t nominated for Friday afternoon’s meeting. She was impressive when winning on debut and was runner up behind the tightly assessed performer Noble Trick at a recent trial effort so she must be respected. KEAYANG SHADOWBOX (8) has been steadily working back into his best form and strikes a winnable assignment now. He wasn’t beaten by far when second behind the classy pacer The Golden Hook at Mildura on October 20. HELLAVA DEAL (7) was competing against stronger opposition when she was last in work. She is awkwardly drawn but should be finding the line well. SELECTIONS: BAZZAS LEGACY (4), WINSHEMAY (9), KEAYANG SHADOWBOX (8), HELLAVA DEAL (7)

OVERVIEW:CEMETERY BAY (1) has been competing against the open class pacers at Mildura and appears to be well graded in this event. His last win at Mildura was in a much harder race (National Rating 60-75) back in August and he is perfectly drawn for this assignment. GOOD BOOTS BINDI (2) is a handy sprinter and is perfectly drawn to gain a trail just behind the speed so she should be dangerous at the end. SHIRLEY NOT (3) has been racing in career best form with three recent Mildura victories to her credit. She is stepping up in grade but she is versatile and should make her presence felt. ROYAL SAXON (6) will need some luck from the wide draw but he ran a strong race for third behind SHIRLEY NOT (3) on October 20 and will go well with normal luck in running. BACK: CEMETERY BAY (1) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: CEMETERY BAY (1), GOOD BOOTS BINDI (2), SHIRLEY NOT (3), ROYAL SAXON (6)

OVERVIEW: HAPPY AS CAN BE (3) finished fourth in a heat of the South Australian Cup then followed with a seventh in the Final. He will enjoy racing against this class and is drawn to go close. CAULONIA TERROR (5) was a winner at Mildura on September 18 and he was unlucky behind Lower Manhattan two starts ago as he was held up behind tiring horses at the 700m mark. He is likely to settle in the second half of the field from his awkward alley but he should be hitting the line strongly. MY ULTIMATE BILLY (2) was placed behind the in-form pacer The Golden Hook two starts ago and wasn’t far away at his latest fifth. He is worth a ticket each way from his good draw. FOXY TWO GLOVES (4) led out then took cover when a game second behind the Emma Stewart prepared Star Vision on Swan Hill Cup night so a bold showing is expected. SELECTIONS: HAPPY AS CAN BE (3), CAULONIA TERROR (5), MY ULTIMATE BILLY (2), FOXY TWO GLOVES (4)

OVERVIEW: SHUDABOUGHTABOAT (1) performed very well at the trials prior to a third behind the smart South Australian pacer Rankine when resuming. He should be building on his fitness and will take beating from the pole position. EAGLEYE (2) has been racing very consistently and ran a game race behind Talknplay at Swan Hill two starts ago, where she was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off solidly. This race is no harder and she worth thought again. HILLTOP CRUNCH (8) has remained undefeated in two starts since resuming from a break and should gain an economical run from his trailing draw so there is no reason why he can’t win again. CLARENDEN ARCADIA (3) and MY ULTIMATE HENRY (6) are both racing well enough to figure in the finish. BACK: SHUDABOUGHTABOAT (1) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: SHUDABOUGHTABOAT (1), EAGLEYE (2), HILLTOP CRUNCH (8), MY ULTIMATE HENRY (6)

OVERVIEW:SOLS ME NAME (4) is first up since tiring in the Vicbred Super Series Semi-Final in September. While it was a Group 1 series against the best horses in his age group, he did appear below his best in that performance. He was a good third in his heat the week prior. He is a classy horse at his best, remains lightly raced and has won two recent trials. BANJO STAR (2) is racing better than his numerical form suggests. He got too wide and too far back last start, making it difficult to make up ground. His previous effort was a smart fourth at Wagga in good time. MISTER HUNTER (9) is one of the best horses in this race on ability. He has 11 starts for six wins, including a Group 1 success in the APG Gold Bullion as a two-year-old in 2023. However, he hasn't raced since June 2024, and that was his only start since May 2023. He has had just two recent trials, making this a massive ask. First up after 865 days and now competing outside aged-group racing, he will need to be very sharp to win. DELIGHTFUL MIKI (1) is a smart, lightly raced mare who gets the ace barrier and the opportunity to use it to her advantage. Also strongly respecting ALOT LIKE JEANNIE (8), who has been racing at the top level among the three-year-old fillies this season. She won a Vicbred Super Series heat and possesses a brilliant turn of foot. She will need some luck from the barrier. BACK: SOLS ME NAME (4)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SOLS ME NAME (4), BANJO STAR (2), MISTER HUNTER (9), DELIGHTFUL MIKI (1)

OVERVIEW: This race is full of progressive horses, making it a very competitive event. MASTER LOUEY (10) is a smart colt who rarely runs a bad race. He put together some really nice performances before winning well last start after leading at Ballarat. This assignment will be harder, as he is unlikely to find the front and will be racing over the short trip. However, he has the class to be competitive. STORM VENDETTA (6) contested the same race won by Master Louey last start but was too far back and wide to make up the ground. He defeated MASTER LOUEY (10) three starts ago at Ballarat, coming off his back to run past him. He has a great turn of foot, although the barrier makes things tricky. TOORAM DANNY (9) flashed home strongly at Echuca last start and was only narrowly defeated. He rarely runs a bad race and should get a good trip, following through early into the running line. SIR NIPPA (3) is first up back in Victoria following a campaign in Tasmania and could appreciate the change of scenery. HOLLOW LOG (4), METRO MEMORY (5), SAVANNAH BREEZE (7) and CHAINSMOKE (11) are all capable of featuring with the right luck in what looks a very even field. SELECTIONS: MASTER LOUEY (10), STORM VENDETTA (6), TOORAM DANNY (9), SIR NIPPA (3)

OVERVIEW:TALISKER SKIPPER (11) is in good form after winning well at Kilmore last start when leading. He will need to make his own luck from barrier 11 here, but his best sectional times are around two seconds quicker than the rest of this field. ARTY MCFLY (3) is a two-year-old having his fourth career start. He is first up here after finishing fifth in the $100,000 APG Final last start. This is his first attempt outside two-year-old racing. HALF PRICE BRIDE (9) was too wide and too far back to make up the ground at Echuca last start. She has been a little unlucky recently but finds an opportunity to turn her form around if she can map well. THE IRISHMAN (1) is a horse who isn't afraid to do some work in his races. He is racing well and gets the ace barrier, which he can use to his advantage. Also respecting CHEEZ (8), who is first up for new trainer Tasmyn Potter. SELECTIONS: TALISKER SKIPPER (11), ARTY MCFLY (3), HALF PRICE BRIDE (9), THE IRISHMAN (1),

OVERVIEW:DANCE FIGHTER (7) was a dominant winner at Maryborough last start when leading. It was a slowly run race, but she let down nicely and got the job done. She has been racing well and comes into this with winning confidence. This assignment will be tougher from the barrier. OLIVER SMUDGE (3) was eye-catching when returning with a win last start after three years on the sidelines. He galloped early, caught the field, made his move around them and was too good when letting down late. He will improve again with fitness, but his manners remain a big risk. SHINELIKETHESUN (5) is the best swooper in this field on the clock. If she is close enough, she is good enough, but she comes with some risk after galloping at her last four starts. ELARIA (1) is having her third career start. She finished third on debut at Maryborough, doing everything right and running safely to the line. She galloped last start, although it appeared she may have suffered some interference that caused her to break stride. She recovered and ran on reasonably well. She should produce an improved performance here with added fitness. SELECTIONS: DANCE FIGHTER (7), OLIVER SMUDGE (3), SHINELIKETHESUN (5), ELARIA (1)

OVERVIEW:WIND STORM (8) was an impressive first-up winner at Maryborough last start, racing away to score by 21.9 metres. She has the best sectional times in this field, but will need to overcome the tricky barrier eight. FRANKS ALOT (2) is an interesting trotter. He raced in the breeze to finish a good second on debut, then followed that up with a dominant win at Maryborough before getting it wrong with his manners last start. If he can trot throughout and get forward, he will be a big threat. BIRMINGHAM GIRL (1) was good on debut when finishing third but got it wrong with her manners at Kilmore last start. She will need to trot throughout here. BIG RAIN (5) is a well-mannered trotter who is always competitive. With the right run and some luck, she can capitalise. BACK: WIND STORM (8) –2 units (win) SELECTIONS: WIND STORM (8), FRANKS ALOT (2), BIRMINGHAM GIRL (1), BIG RAIN (5)

OVERVIEW:BUILDTHEMANASTATUE (1) returns from a short campaign in Tasmania. He had a tough run but still finished fifth in the $75,000 Dandy Patch Final at Hobart last start after winning his heat. He is a classy runner, but faces the challenge of being a two-year-old competing against older horses. Barrier one certainly suits. BEAU BECA (2) led and battled on well for second at Kilmore last start. He is racing okay and should map well here. ARTIST (6) has been racing reasonably well, although he can be a little inconsistent. He finished fifth last start after racing in the breeze. Barrier six makes things tricky, but at his best he is a winning chance. BONA KHAN (3) is a fast horse who can be effective whether saved for one run or using his gate speed. If he gets some luck here, he cannot be forgotten. BACK: BUILDTHEMANASTATUE (1)– 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: BUILDTHEMANASTATUE (1), BEAU BECA (2), ARTIST (6), BONA KHAN (3)

OVERVIEW: This looks a very even maiden with plenty of chances. Any horse in this field could win, and it wouldn't come as a surprise. EVA EXPRESS (7) has been racing okay. She led and took a sit at Kilmore last start before running home well to be beaten by a neck. She faces a more challenging barrier here, but should continue to improve, with this being just her fifth career start. SPOT THE DEVIL (1) flashed home nicely to finish third in the same race last start. He gets a change of luck here with barrier one, a draw he has had only once previously in his 48 career starts. ITS JUST RUBY (2) looked physically outstanding at Kilmore last start. I was on track before the race and she really caught my eye. She also performed better than the market suggested. She was shuffled back to last but ran home well, and gets a much better barrier here. She has the gate speed to make use of the draw and could be an improver in this event. DYGANALI (6) has been racing okay and looks ready to break through for his maiden victory. Barrier six is the main challenge. BACK: ITS JUST RUBY (2)– 1 unit (win)/ 2 units (place) SELECTIONS: EVA EXPRESS (7), SPOT THE DEVIL (1), ITS JUST RUBY (2), DYGANALI (6)

OVERVIEW:UNCLE TREV (6) has been racing regularly at Shepparton and Wagga recently and gets his first look at Melton here. He is a smart horse who rarely runs a bad race and has the best sectional times in this event. The barrier makes things difficult, but his class should shine through. SPRINGFIELD RIVER (5) is a progressive pacer who I believe we haven't seen the best of yet. He was a good second last start in a tough race, chasing runaway leaders and letting down nicely. The barrier is awkward here, but he is racing well. SPEEDY HEALEY (3) rarely runs a bad race and is always capable of letting down nicely when he gets a good trip. THEROUX (2) was inconvenienced last start when dragged back, but still managed to let down reasonably well. He is racing well and should map positively here. HEZROCKINROYALTY (4) finds his sort of race today. He ran second behind LOCHINVAR MAGIC and hit the line well. He looks the one to beat. LOCHINVAR LEADER (1) will find this race tougher but he will love the inside draw and the track. He is a major threat. LORD ZARIAS (5) and NAROBI (2) are also chances.

SWEETHEARTED (4) has won both her trials at Globe Derby and Gawler. She ran a 1.57.9 mile rate at Gawler in her most recent trial. She looks like a promising filly and a big threat tonight. TIGER MUMFF (2), GETONTHEBUS (6) and MAJOR APDAL (5) are also chances.

SWEET NICKY (4) ran second behind NORMANS GIRL last start here at Port Pirie which was her first run in SA. She should be able to improve off that run. She should be hard to beat today. ROLL WITH MUSTARD (7) finds the sort of race he can win today. If he can get the right run then he will be storming home late. OUR WILD IRISH ROSE (3) and HEATHBERN BRUCE (1) are also chances.

BAY LA VILLE (7) finds an easier race today after running second in a heat of the Southern Cross on Saturday. She finishes off her races well and she should get a great run into the race from the second row today. DARLINGTON (6) was very impressive last start when she broke her maiden. Today will be tougher but she is worth consideration because she has massive potential and plenty of improvement ahead of her. BERSAGLIERE (2) and BUSTNLOOSE (4) are also chances.

REACH THE PEAK (6) led all of the way at Port Pirie last start in what was a dominant performance where he won by 11.6 meters. He is a big chance today if he can repeat that sort of run. SRIRACHA (8), KETO (9) and ALORA (5) are all big chances in a very even race.

B T CAPTIVATE (6) finds a much easier race today compared to recent outings. The draw is tough but if he is anywhere near his best then he should be hard to beat. ALOHA PRINCESS (9), AFTER THE CHASE (7) and CHARMING MAJOR (2) are also chances. OVERVIEW:OUR SWEET JEANNIE (11) deserves another chance here after getting it wrong at the start when favourite last week. Despite mapping close enough thereafter, the race developed into a sprint home, and she was finding the line well. Her form prior was against the A-grade runners of her age group, and despite going to the back row as an O/D runner, she can atone against what is a much weaker line-up. IM DUSTEE (10) broke through for a deserved win last start when able to find the lead and hang on against lesser opposition. She stays in a similar class with the junior claim, so warrants consideration again. MUSSEL SHOALS (2) is a quick beginner second up from a break, and her likely map over the short trip makes her an attractive option. MASTER MIKI (4) is one of several who can show speed here off the front row and will find this grade more to his liking, so is open to improvement. There are a few others who have claims but will need things to work out, including EAGLE MAJOR (1), MAJOR ORION (7) and FULL STEAM AHEAD (9). BACK: OUR SWEET JEANNIE (11) – 4 units (win) SELECTIONS:OUR SWEET JEANNIE (11), IM DUSTEE (10), MUSSEL SHOALS (2), MASTER MIKI (4)

OVERVIEW:ALCATRAZ GIRL (2) is a speedy beginner who got things wrong here last time out and had to drift back to last before finishing close enough under the circumstances. She gets appealing conditions over the short trip to potentially find the front and take plenty of catching if she can secure that position. SALSBOY (1) is a veteran who comes up with a great draw to map perfectly, like his most recent placing four runs back when he lobbed behind the leader at Bendigo. He can improve sharply on his numerical form. OLLY ODD POTTS (9) tends to hit a purple patch of form and then go out of it, as her history would suggest, but assessing her on her past two wins, she must be considered. She gets a junior claim to stay in a winnable race. QUEENHIGH FLUSH (10) is going well this season, and she's a mare who likes to come with one run, so if the tempo is genuine enough, she can be strong late. OHHEMJAY CRESCO (4) will find this easier than last time and can also be considered on an each-way basis. SELECTIONS:ALCATRAZ GIRL (2), SALSBOY (1), OLLY ODD POTTS (9), QUEENHIGH FLUSH (10)

OVERVIEW:PLUTOPHOBIA (1) has made an impression in his two career starts at Wagga and has proven he can run time at that track and show enough speed to position himself well from an inside draw. While that form can often be questionable coming to Shepparton, you must respect the stable and what appears to be a positive set-up. MY ROC (2) was good in winning on debut here last week, and that was from a wide draw, backing up some solid efforts at the trials. He gets a better draw and must be respected again. EEBEEBEE (8) finally broke through for her maiden last start after several placings where she was favoured in the market. She gets a soft draw here, and her experience may be an advantage, being a 4yo taking on 2yos who will be at the top end of the market. ATOMIK GO ANNA (10) gets another challenging draw, and she was finding the line quite well last time from a similar set-up. She's taken on some nice quality this season to suggest there's ability, but she will need some luck. SELECTIONS:PLUTOPHOBIA (1), MY ROC (2), EEBEEBEE (8), ATOMIK GO ANNA (10)

OVERVIEW:ELIANA (1) looks to get the right set-up to break her maiden here, coming off some nice runs from difficult draws. Now she can use her speed to either lead or catch the right cover over the short trip. She's gone close a couple of times at this track when she's been able to grab a forward position. TOUCH OF REALITY (3) has threatened a few times to break her maiden status, recording six seconds from 11 starts this season. She has tactical speed, so she will go close again. ALCATRAZ MISS (2) gets a good draw after some challenging back-row marbles, so she should be able to get the right trip to go close, but like many of these, she's had plenty of chances to get into the winner's circle. AMERICAN GRANGE (7) and BACK DATED (8) are first starters from the same stable who have trialled fairly leading into their debut runs. While they have awkward draws to overcome, they're worth keeping safe in a race of this strength. BACK: ELIANA (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:ELIANA (1), TOUCH OF REALITY (3), ALCATRAZ MISS (2), BACK DATED (8)

OVERVIEW:TOBYS SHOUT (8) deserves another chance after I had him on top in a more difficult race than this last time, where he didn't get much luck. He was a solid winner three runs back when a short-priced favourite, and while he doesn't have the best record at this track, he has had some excuses. He will need luck again, but if he gets it, he's better than most here. KRAKEY (5) was able to break through for his first win this season last start, where he did the work outside the speed and was too strong. The draw means he'll likely have to earn it again, but he's going well. ROCK THE JET (3) is a 2yo filly taking on the older horses but was able to lead and win last time out, so respect the likely map in her favour. Of the rest, they're for the most part unreliable in terms of consistency, but SON OF A BROAD (1) and ALTA BAYAMO (6) could win without surprising when they get it together. SELECTIONS:TOBYS SHOUT (8), KRAKEY (5), ROCK THE JET (3), SON OF A BROAD (1)

OVERVIEW:SPIRITED GIGI (6) finds a more suitable grade having taken on some smarter types in recent starts, but when he dropped back in class three runs ago, he was an easy winner, leading and winning by a space. He's building a nice record, and although there are a couple going okay here, he looks well suited. ALDEBARAN DENBAY (5) has been a model of consistency for the new stable, and although he keeps stepping up in grade, he deserves respect again with a positive draw. He seems better when he can lead, but it's not certain he gets that role here. STRAIGHT TO THETOP (2) is always thereabouts under mobile conditions, and this draw looks favourable to use her speed over the short trip and look to lead all the way. She will go close but has had plenty of chances in similar circumstances. SHEZALOVER (3) has been going well for the new stable, and although this may be slightly trickier than her past couple, she may map well enough to be in the finish. SELECTIONS:SPIRITED GIGI (6), ALDEBARAN DENBAY (5), STRAIGHT TO THETOP (2), SHEZALOVER (3)

OVERVIEW:LATHER ME UP (6) is a 2yo filly who was well supported against the older horses last start but cost herself any chance by pacing roughly at the start. She was forced to the rear of the field, only to make ground again late and finish a close-up 5th. That was her first run for the new stable, and she finds an easier race this time to atone. LORIMERMAJOR (5) has been thereabouts recently, getting closer to notching a second win for the season. He's likely to drift back and hope to overpower them from the rear of the small field, so he'll need the right tempo. TREACHEROUSTIMES (1) has the potential to use his speed from the inside draw and look to hold out those drawn immediately outside him as challengers for the lead. He was able to win from this draw back in August. The three stablemates are all drawn alongside each other, with GOODTIME MAE (2), ENABLE ME (3) and ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (4) all having claims but being dependent on the maps they get. SELECTIONS:LATHER ME UP (6), LORIMERMAJOR (5), TREACHEROUSTIMES (1), ENABLE ME (3)

OVERVIEW:YOUR SO RICH (4) was terribly unlucky on debut at Maryborough, where he showed good gate speed to position behind the leader and was travelling like the winner until that leader broke at a crucial stage, severely checking him out of the race. He managed to regain his gait and finish 4th. There was market support on that occasion, so with even luck this time, he can get the job done. GATSYS DELIGHT (5) isn't a big filly, but she showed some ability on debut. She displayed some greenness but did well to finish 3rd in decent time. Hopefully, she can mature from that experience and run well. KYVALLEY DAYTONA (2) started off the back row on debut and, as a result, came with one run and found the line okay. He was in the same race as the top pick here, but circumstances were different between them. KYVALLEY DANNY (1) is the stablemate out of the same race but was safely held by some of the others, although the draw aids her chances for minor money. BACK: YOUR SO RICH (4) – 4 units (win) SELECTIONS:YOUR SO RICH (4), GATSYS DELIGHT (5), KYVALLEY DAYTONA (2), KYVALLEY DANNY (1)
